suite: annotate bind form (a drag keeps the pick, the ends by name, the leader)
expect_red: ...and no leader is drawn on a first bind, even with an end chosen

mutations.contract: With nothing bound at the other end there is no leader: a line with one real end would be a guess.
mutations.note: Invents the missing end -- the other face of the part -- so a first bind draws a leader to a face nobody bound.
mutations.replace: if (!other || !other.bound) other = { name: "guess", bound: { sha256: pick.sha256, faceId: pick.faceId === 0 ? 1 : 0 } };
